verdict.rationale: GitCafe's docs say Buildkite builds appear on a repository's CI tab and as checks on pull requests. For GitHub-synced repositories, GitHub Actions results arrive as checks. Those checks feed into rulesets that can require passing checks, and into stack views that show each member's check state. missing for 10: a generic commit-status/checks API for arbitrary external CI services beyond Buildkite and GitHub Actions, explicit evidence of checks shown on individual commits (not just PRs), independent or hands-on corroboration.
